name: skilltotal
description: SkillTotal by AIR checks every skill before it runs and every skill install before it starts, and shows you the verdict. It sends a content hash, the skill's name or the install link, never the files.

api_key.title: SkillTotal API key
api_key.description: Make one at skilltotal.com/account/settings/api-keys (free; choose Never under expiry). Without a key, skills and installs aren't checked.
